element_title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas
title: Trees on a site over 1,000 m2: 1 large plus 1 medium per additional 400 m2, or 1 large per additional 900 m2 (Table 3.3a)
text: Table 3.3a: > 1,000m2 - 1 large tree and 1 medium tree for each additional 400m2 in excess of 1000m2 OR 1 large tree for each additional 900m2 in excess of 1000m2 AND small trees to suit area.

parts.label: 1 medium per whole 400 m2 over 1,000 m2

notes: verify: read as (a) 1 large tree plus 1 medium tree for each whole 400 m2 over 1,000 m2, or (b) 1 large tree plus 1 large tree for each whole 900 m2 over 1,000 m2. Other readings: 1 large and 1 medium per 400 m2 each; or (b) without the base large tree. 'For each additional' counted in whole increments (no 'or part thereof', unlike ch4p1 Table 1.2a); round(x - 0.4999) is floor.

verified.note: p31 Table 3.3a >1,000m2 cell: does not say whether the large tree is also per 400 m2 increment, or whether a part increment counts.
